latest_news.headline: Israeli troops reportedly entered Lebanese-army-held pilot zone and built roadblock
latest_news.source: AFP via France 24; Al Jazeera/AFP; Lebanese NNA and military source
latest_news.summary: Israeli troops reportedly entered Zawtar al-Gharbiyah overnight and erected an earthen barrier about 100 metres from the town square. AFP observed the barrier; a Lebanese military source called the move a violation of the June framework. Three Lebanese soldiers were separately wounded while clearing unexploded ordnance.
latest_news.impact: Fresh evidence that the June framework remains under operational strain; confirms the already-active ceasefire_violation signal but does not exceed the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.

latest_news.headline: Ukrainian drones reach Yekaterinburg, more than 2,000 km inside Russia
latest_news.source: The Guardian briefing citing local officials and Wildberries; Reuters image/reporting attribution
latest_news.summary: Three long-range drones hit the roof of a Wildberries warehouse in Yekaterinburg and started a fire. About 800 people were evacuated and no casualties were reported; the Kremlin discussed stronger infrastructure protection.
latest_news.impact: Material expansion of demonstrated Ukrainian strike reach, but the Russia-Ukraine tracker is already at a 99% ceiling and no canonical signal changes.

latest_news.headline: Turkey calls new Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey defense pact technically equivalent to NATO Article 5
latest_news.source: Reuters-indexed reporting; Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan statement
latest_news.summary: Ankara said the mutual-defense clause in the new Makkah pact is technically the same as NATO Article 5 while maintaining that the agreement does not conflict with NATO obligations.
latest_news.impact: Important allied-position change and regional coupling consideration, but no nuclear-sharing change or Turkish nuclear signal; Turkey remains 5%.

latest_news.headline: UN Security Council and EU condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and shipping
latest_news.source: UN Security Council press statement reported by Saudi Gazette; EU spokesperson
latest_news.summary: The Security Council condemned Houthi missile attacks against Saudi Arabia since July 13 and commercial vessels since July 22. The EU separately condemned strikes against Najran and Marib and warned of a dangerous escalation.
latest_news.impact: Stronger multilateral pressure but no verified operational de-escalation; Yemen/Red Sea remains 85% with existing signals unchanged.

latest_news.headline: Iran says Hormuz deal is close but reopening remains conditional as another UAE carrier is hit
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Iran and Oman are very close to agreement on a new Hormuz route, but Iran said that alone would not reopen the waterway: Tehran also wants U.S. compensation and acceptance of its conditions. The UAE said an Iranian missile struck another carrier affiliated with ADNOC while it transited the strait; no injuries were reported. This reconfirms oil_infrastructure_threat while diplomacy_active and hormuz_controlled_not_closed remain active. Iran conventional is already at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling, so no additional probability was added.

latest_news.headline: U.S. intelligence reportedly links Leipzig explosive drone to Russian government
latest_news.text: The Wall Street Journal, citing U.S. officials familiar with intelligence reporting, said the explosive-laden drone found beside a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle likely belonged to the Russian government. German federal prosecutors still have not issued public attribution and NATO has announced no Article 4/5 action. The report materially sharpens the NATO hybrid-risk watch but does not meet either configured russia signal threshold; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan reports no abnormal activity under PRC traffic-control order during Typhoon Hana
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Taiwan said a PRC traffic-control order off Fujian was issued as Typhoon Hana approached. Taiwan's defence ministry reported no abnormal ship or aircraft activity; weather attribution means no new military_buildup signal is activated.

latest_news.headline: UN Security Council extends Red Sea attack reporting as members condemn recent Houthi strikes
latest_news.text: UN meeting coverage says the Security Council adopted Resolution 2826 by 13-0-2, extending monthly reporting on Houthi Red Sea attacks through January 15, 2027. Several members cited recent Houthi strikes against Saudi Arabia and freedom-of-navigation risks. Existing ceasefire_violation remains active; no separate probability increment is applied.
sources: United Nations Security Council meeting coverage

latest_news.headline: Houthis strike Marib again; UN warns Yemen is nearing wider conflict
latest_news.text: Reuters reported ballistic missiles and drones hit displacement camps and residential neighbourhoods in Marib, killing two and wounding 14 according to local authorities. The attack followed strikes that killed at least 30 government troops. The UN envoy called this the highest risk of renewed large-scale conflict since the 2022 truce. The existing ceasefire_violation indicator is renewed; risk holds 85 because the lane already absorbed the escalation and no distinct infrastructure strike or verified buildup was established.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan continues scheduled Han Kuang coastal-strike and continuity drills
latest_news.text: Reuters reported President Lai overseeing coastal-strike training during Taiwan’s annual war games. The exercise is defensive and scheduled; no fresh PLA blockade, Chinese live-fire action or armed clash was verified, so China remains 24 raw / 29 coupled with no canonical signal change.

latest_news.headline: Lebanon and Israel agree shortlist for possible disarmament-verification force
latest_news.text: Reuters reported that the parties agreed a shortlist of countries that could send troops to verify a future Hezbollah-disarmament arrangement. Later reporting described positive movement on borders and prisoners. This reinforces diplomacy_active but does not offset continuing truce violations or justify a probability cut.

latest_news.headline: U.S. intelligence reportedly widens window for a possible Russian test of NATO
latest_news.text: The Wall Street Journal, citing new U.S. intelligence assessments, reported scenarios from hybrid attacks to a limited eastern-flank incursion between autumn 2026 and 2029; reporting says a ground incursion remains the least likely case. Lithuania also warned of possible false-flag drone attacks on Baltic infrastructure. No attack or NATO Article 4/5 action was verified, so the Russia tracker holds 70 raw / 80 coupled with no new canonical signal.
sources: Wall Street Journal via Kyiv Independent
Lithuanian defence minister via LRT/Kyiv Independent

latest_news.title: ADNOC says 15 of its vessels have been attacked since war began; three this week
latest_news.summary: ADNOC said missiles or drones have targeted 15 company vessels transiting Hormuz since the conflict began, including three this week; one crew member was killed and 20 injured. The disclosure materially reinforces the scale of shipping risk, but Iran conventional remains unchanged at its 95 raw ceiling with existing hormuz_controlled_not_closed, hormuz_mining and oil_infrastructure_threat signals already active.
latest_news.sources: ADNOC statement via Gulf News; Bloomberg; OilPrice

latest_news.headline: Congo completes first known prisoner transfer to AFC/M23 under Qatar deal
latest_news.text: Reuters and the ICRC said Congolese authorities released 15 prisoners to AFC/M23. The handover is one of the first concrete implementation steps under last year's Qatar agreement; it reinforces the existing diplomacy_active signal but does not resolve the wider conflict.
sources: International Committee of the Red Cross

latest_news.headline: African rights alliance seeks inquiry into Sudan chemical-weapons allegations
latest_news.text: The Sudan Coalition called for an independent inquiry into older allegations of chemical-weapons use by Sudan's army. No fresh attack was independently verified, so the item is retained as accountability context rather than a new configured scoring signal.

latest_news.headline: Houthi attacks kill scores in Yemen and wound 11 civilians in Saudi Arabia
latest_news.text: AFP reported 61 Yemeni government troops killed in ballistic-missile and drone attacks across Thursday-Friday, the worst losses since 2022. Saudi authorities separately said Houthi shelling in Najran wounded 11 civilians, including a four-year-old child; Yemen’s defence ministry promised a response. The EU and Canada subsequently condemned the attacks on Najran and Marib and called for an immediate halt; this is an allied-position update, not a new attack or an additional scoring input.

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The official IAEA Iran Board-report index still shows GOV/2026/33 dated 4 Jun as the newest safeguards report. No fresh evidence of 90% enrichment, a nuclear test, Fordow activation or restored/denied access threshold surfaced; raw/coupled risk holds 56/64

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Aug. 8 that Iran and Oman are very close to a new Hormuz-route agreement, but Tehran said reopening also depends on U.S. compensation and acceptance of Iranian conditions. The UAE simultaneously said an Iranian missile hit another ADNOC-affiliated carrier in the strait, with no injuries. oil_infrastructure_threat is reconfirmed; diplomacy_active and hormuz_controlled_not_closed remain active. hormuz_mining aged out during deploy under the configured TTL. Raw/coupled risk holds at the 95/100 ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Aug. 7 agreement on a shortlist of possible troop contributors for a future Hezbollah-disarmament verification force, renewing diplomacy_active after its older event instance reached TTL. Continuing truce violations keep ceasefire_violation active. Raw/coupled risk holds 95/100

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, AP and the signatories confirm the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement among Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and nuclear-armed Pakistan: an armed attack on one is to be treated as an attack on all. The pact is the scan's principal allied-position change, but its public text does not establish nuclear sharing and does not meet Türkiye's configured nuclear_rhetoric_official, diplomacy_active or missile_range_test thresholds; risk holds 5/deterrent

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h review found no independently corroborated India-Pakistan force buildup or new cross-border clash. Commentary and anniversary coverage were not scored; risk holds 15/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h indexes produced humanitarian/context reporting but no independently corroborated new cross-border strike, clash or force buildup. Risk holds 46/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: War remains at the model ceiling, but russia_ukraine:military_buildup expired under its configured TTL during the 09Z deploy. The prior report of a roughly 90-person North Korean missile unit deploying to Voronezh was not freshly corroborated inside this scan window. The signal cleanup changes state, not the 99/imminent probability

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Wall Street Journal, citing U.S. officials familiar with intelligence reporting, said the explosive-laden drone found at Leipzig/Halle likely belonged to the Russian government. German prosecutors have not publicly attributed the attack and NATO has announced no Article 4/5 action. This sharpens the hybrid-risk watch but activates neither configured russia signal; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Baseline PRC pressure persists. Reuters reported Taiwan coastal-strike drills, while Taiwan's MND said a PRC traffic-control order off Fujian during Typhoon Hana produced no abnormal ship or aircraft activity. Weather attribution and the absence of abnormal activity do not justify a new configured signal

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, AP and Yonhap confirm North Korea launched at least one short-range ballistic missile from Wonsan toward the sea east of the Korean Peninsula on Aug. 6, its first ballistic launch since late June and shortly before expected U.S.-ROK exercises. The canonical missile_range_test signal activates; raw risk rises 18→24 (ELEVATED). No nuclear test, ICBM launch, impact in Japan or strike on another state was reported

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: An Aug. 7 alliance of African rights groups called for an independent investigation into older allegations that Sudan's army used chemical weapons. The appeal and July sanctions are serious accountability context, but no fresh chemical attack, deployment or other configured event was independently verified in this scan. Risk holds 94/imminent with no new canonical signal

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UNICEF/OCHA document continuing attacks during the Gaza ceasefire. Reuters/AP now report Uganda approved conditional participation in the proposed International Stabilization Force, with Morocco also pledged; no deployment date exists and the plan remains stalled. ceasefire_violation and diplomacy_active are both active; the evidence-based near-ceiling probability holds 98/imminent

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN Security Council heard fresh warnings of institutional collapse, famine risk in four counties, deadly cholera and attacks on aid workers as the political settlement frays. This materially worsens humanitarian and political context but does not independently verify a new configured military_buildup, ceasefire_violation or diplomacy_refused event. Risk holds 19/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Aug. 7 Congo-AFC/M23 prisoner transfer remains a constructive data point, but eastern_drc:diplomacy_active expired under its configured TTL during the 09Z deploy because no fresh implementation step crossed the renewal rule in this run. Raw/coupled risk holds 53/imminent amid unresolved fighting, territorial control and Rwanda-support allegations

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Houthi missile/drone attacks on Marib and southern Saudi Arabia keep ceasefire_violation active at 85/severe. The UN Security Council extended Red Sea attack reporting and members condemned recent Houthi strikes; that allied response does not add a distinct kinetic signal

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h review found no distinct new attack, deployment or foreign-support delivery beyond older context. The prior foreign-support indicator aged out under the configured 168-hour rule; risk holds 43/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Aug. 6 that China had apparently acknowledged two coast-guard deaths from the Aug. 11, 2025 Scarborough Shoal collision. This is retrospective confirmation, not a fresh maritime clash; ongoing confrontations and treaty risk remain high, but no new signal or score change was applied

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The only fresh indexed item was an uncorroborated commentary about a Pakistan-Somalia defence pact. No new UKMTO/JMIC piracy incident or configured threshold was verified; risk holds 28/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: A local report says security forces conducted an operation against suspects linked to the 22 Jul Narathiwat checkpoint attack. Without independent corroboration or evidence of a broader force buildup, no signal was activated; risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h RSS returned no fresh Kuwait-Iraq border-drone incident. Earlier hostile-drone spillover remains the baseline context; no configured signal changed and risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAQ INTERNAL CONFLICT
dashboard_trackers.notes: Raw risk holds 45 after Iraq placed military and security forces on heightened readiness as an Iran-aligned militia retaliation deadline expired. Field exercises and troop movements were reported; Hadi al-Ameri urged postponement, but the configured military_buildup signal remains active

dashboard_trackers.name: KENYA SOMALIA BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: A local Aug. 7 report said six people were wounded, one critically, when a vehicle hit a suspected IED near El Wak in Mandera County. It follows the July 29 ambush that killed five officers, but the fresh incident remains single-source and does not independently establish a broader military buildup or infrastructure-strike threshold; risk holds 25/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: EGYPT MEDITERRANEAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Regional reporting says operations resumed at Damietta after the earlier drone attack. No fresh Mediterranean strike was verified and no canonical de-escalatory signal applies; risk holds 20/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: SPAIN MOROCCO CEUTA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Middle East Eye reported the Ceuta migrant-disaster death toll had risen to 141, while most entrants had already returned to Morocco. The humanitarian toll rose, but no new military buildup or Spain-Morocco interstate kinetic threshold emerged; risk holds 22/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: ETHIOPIA TIGRAY
dashboard_trackers.notes: Critical Threats Project assessed the Aug. 1 western-Tigray fighting as major but limited and found no later clash in the review window. ENDF reinforcement/checkpoint activity and separate ENDF/TPLF mobilization near Alamata remain the live configured indicator. The older clash and framework-breakdown indicators have decayed; risk holds 32/critical
